exposure: placenta accreta spectrum with placenta previa
placenta accreta spectrum without placenta previa
outcome: risk factors for placenta accreta spectrum
antepartum diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: 351 women with pathology-confirmed placenta accreta spectrum deliveries with hysterectomy from two U.S. referral centers between January 2010 and June 2019
finding: Placenta accreta spectrum without previa was less likely to be diagnosed antepartum and associated with similar rates of severe maternal morbidity compared to placenta accreta spectrum with previa.
